```yaml
name: CockroachDB Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  test-cockroachdb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Build and Test with CockroachDB
        run: mvn clean verify -DenableCockroachDBTests=true -DskipTests=false
        env:
          # Ensure Docker is available for TestContainers
          DOCKER_HOST: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
```
